date_note: Infosertec's page, published 27 November, gives no earlier day for the charges (its date line also shows 25 November).
exec: Infosertec reports the US Justice Department charged a former technology director of a ransomware data-recovery firm, which it says charged victims for decryption while paying the attackers.
geo_basis: country: US Department of Justice charges, as relayed; no city stated
plain: Infosertec reports US prosecutors charged a former technology director of RansomwareHelp with electronic fraud. These are allegations, not a conviction.

sources.name: Infosertec: EE. UU. acusa a un exejecutivo de estafar a víctimas de ransomware

summary: Infosertec reports, citing TechCrunch, that the US Department of Justice charged a former technology director of RansomwareHelp, a data-recovery company, with electronic fraud. According to the charges as relayed, the company charged victims to decrypt files but paid the attackers. The page states these are accusations, not a conviction.
title: US charges ex-executive of ransomware recovery firm RansomwareHelp with defrauding victims, Infosertec reports

validation.note: One publisher (Infosertec, Spanish) relaying TechCrunch; the TechCrunch and DOJ pages were not read (TechCrunch returned 403) and no second publisher was found.
